name: Standing mourning rule (applies on any day): on the death of a national figure or a mass-casualty event, pause every scheduled post within the hour; stay dark through the funeral day; during declared national or MP state mourning resume only non-promotional posts from day three; a plain-text condolence is optional, never a designed card
